artists.biography:
Gruffydd Maredudd Bowen Rhys (born 18 July 1970 in Haverfordwest) is a Welsh musician, performing solo and with several bands, including Super Furry Animals who obtained mainstream success in the 1990s. He also most recently formed the electro-pop outfit Neon Neon with Boom Bip. Their album Stainless Style was nominated for the 2008 Nationwide Mercury Prize. He won the 2011 Welsh Music Prize for his album Hotel Shampoo.
He was educated at Ysgol Dyffryn Ogwen, Bethesda, Gwynedd, North Wales and was awarded a degree in art at Manchester Metropolitan University.

perplexity.description:
Seeking New Gods," released on May 21, 2021, is the seventh solo studio album by Welsh musician Gruff Rhys, issued through Rough Trade Records. The album blends elements of rock and pop, incorporating indie and alternative singer-songwriter styles. It was recorded following a U.S. tour with his band and mixed in Los Angeles, reflecting a polished yet eclectic sound that balances melodic accessibility with experimental touches.

Musically, "Seeking New Gods" continues Rhys's exploration of diverse sonic textures and lyrical themes, inspired in part by the volcanic landscape of Paektu Mountain. The album features a mix of upbeat tracks and more introspective moments, showcasing Rhys's distinctive voice and songwriting maturity within his discography. As a mid-career release, it builds on his previous work by combining thoughtful lyricism with vibrant arrangements, solidifying his reputation as an innovative figure in contemporary rock and pop. Critical reception noted the album's adventurous spirit and cohesive production, contributing positively to Rhys's standing as a solo artist beyond his earlier band projects.
